temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin admits he is not happy at his construction job, feels stuck and unfulfilled, is unsure where to start, and agrees to explore options with Angela.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela had noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his job and was concerned; she believed he might be dissatisfied but had not confirmed it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Kevin's own statements confirm his job dissatisfaction and his openness to exploring alternatives.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is genuinely unhappy in his construction job and is willing to look into career options with Angela's help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and supportive; somewhat hopeful that she can help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Kevin, help him explore possible career paths, and continue the conversation about his future.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin appreciates the job openings and career counseling Angela found; he says he has been thinking a lot and is interested in something creative, such as design or architecture; he agrees to check the resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin was considering a career change and felt supportive and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Kevin's interest in a creative field gives Angela a more specific understanding of his direction and confirms his engagement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is considering a career change and is specifically drawn to creative work like design or architecture; he is willing to explore resources.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep encouraging Kevin, share helpful resources, and help him explore design/architecture options.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela arranges a career-coach meeting; Kevin says he appreciates it but is not sure he's ready; after Angela explains the coach can help him plan and gain confidence, he agrees to give it a shot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin was hesitant about making a career change and felt frustrated and worried.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Partially—Kevin's reluctance confirms his hesitation, but his agreement to meet the coach shows he can be motivated to take a step.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is hesitant but willing to meet a career coach and take a small step forward with Angela's encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and worried before the exchange, then cautiously relieved and encouraged after Kevin agrees.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To motivate Kevin, arrange and support the career-coach meeting, and stay involved every step of the way.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin reports that the career coach has been helpful; he has started online design courses and feels more confident about the change; he says Angela's presence is enough support for now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin was making progress in his career transition and felt proud and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Kevin's report confirms and strengthens her belief that he is progressing and building confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is making concrete progress in a design-related career transition, gaining confidence, and values Angela's ongoing support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offer help when needed, and remain available as a supportive friend.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela tells Kevin she organized a celebration party for his new career; Kevin is grateful and says he couldn't have done it without her support; he agrees to celebrate.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career and felt happy and satisfied.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change—Kevin's gratitude and willingness to celebrate confirm her belief that the transition succeeded and her support mattered.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and appreciates Angela's support; celebrating his success is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To celebrate Kevin's success with him, enjoy the party, and continue being a supportive friend.
